name: Admin MCPs Connectors
description: Superuser manages MCP connectors at /panel/mcps: inspects risk-classified capabilities and requests attributed to a non-interactive connector service actor; creates scoped/expiring credentials, edits scope, rotates or revokes each credential through the panel confirmation modal; receives every secret once; preserves the compatibility token and active toggle. Sensitive tools are identified as preview-plus-confirm actions. Includes the superuser gate: staff non-superusers are redirected to /panel.
